Order 
This Misc. Appeal under Section 173(1) of the Motor Vehicles Act, 1988 has been filed by the appellant assailing the impugned award dated 23.06.2016 passed by III Additional Motor Accident Claims Tribunal, Indore (M.P.) in Claim Case No.53/2015, whereby appellant/claimant minor Jahina through natural guardian has been awarded an amount of Rs.7,000/- only.
2.

entities.text: III Additional Motor Accident Claims Tribunal, Indore (M.P.)
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the appellant submits that the amount awarded in on the lower side looking to the injuries suffered by the claimant.
Hence prays for allowing additional lump sum amount of Rs.20,000/- by allowing the appeal.
3 . Per contra, learned counsel for the Insurance Company has opposed the prayer.

4. Heard and considered the submissions of the learned counsel for NEUTRAL CITATION NO.
2026:MPHC-IND:8820 2 MA-100-2017 the parties and perused the record.
5.

From perusal of the record it is apparent that in the road traffic accident the minor suffered injuries and looking to the totality of the facts and circumstances and the evidence available on record, this Court is of the view that if a lump sum amount of Rs.18,000/- is enhanced that will be just and proper compensation.

6. Accordingly, this Misc. Appeal is partly allowed by enhancing the compensation by Rs.18,000/-
over and above the amount, which has been awarded by the Claims Tribunal.
The amount will also Kumari Jahina Minor Thru.
